name: Bacon, Egg & Cheese Biscuits with Fruit
ingredients:
24 | Biscuits
3 | Liquid Eggs
2 Trays | Bacon
24 slices | American cheese
5 lb | Fresh fruit, cut or ready to serve
As needed | Butter, salt and black pepper
method:
1. Cook bacon on sheet pans or flat top until crisp. Drain and hold warm.
2. Cook the 3 cartons of liquid eggs in a 2 inch full pan in the oven; season lightly. Cut in squares when done.
3. Warm biscuits, split, and place one portion of egg, bacon and one slice of cheese on each.
4. Hold sandwiches covered just long enough to melt the cheese. Serve fruit on the side.
notes: Use batch-cooked bacon and eggs to keep pickup fast. Avoid overholding the biscuits.

name: German Theme Night: Chicken Schnitzel, Pepper-Brown Gravy & German Potato Salad
ingredients:
10 lb | Chicken breast, pounded 1/4-1/2 inch thick
2 lb | Flour
1 carton | Liquid Eggs
3 lb | Plain breadcrumbs or panko
As needed | Salt, black pepper and garlic seasoning
As needed | Oil for shallow frying / griddle cooking
1 1/2 gal | Prepared brown gravy or demi-style gravy
2-3 oz | Coarse black pepper for gravy
15 lb | Idaho potatoes, small dice or thin slice
2 lb | Bacon, diced
2 lb | Onions, diced
2 qt | Red wine vinegar
1-1 1/2 lb | Sugar, adjust to taste
1 qt | Water or light stock
1 bunch | Parsley, chopped
method:
1. Start potatoes in salted boiling water; cook until just tender while the chicken is cooking.
2. Season chicken. Bread flour -> egg -> breadcrumbs. Cook thin cutlets on flat top or in shallow oil until golden and chicken reaches 165°F.
3. Heat brown gravy and finish with plenty of black pepper.
4. For potato salad, render diced bacon, add onions, then vinegar, sugar and water/stock. Bring to a boil.
5. Drain potatoes and fold into the hot bacon-vinegar dressing. Finish with parsley, salt and pepper.
6. Serve schnitzel with pepper-brown gravy and warm German potato salad.
notes: Thin chicken is the key to the 30-minute execution. If possible, pound/portion chicken before service.

name: Breakfast Quesadillas with Salsa
ingredients:
7 | Piadina Shells
2 cartons | Liquid Eggs
2 Trays | Bacon, cooked and chopped
| lb Shredded mozzarella or mixed cheese
1 qt | Salsa
As needed | Butter/oil, salt, pepper
method:
1. Scramble eggs and hold hot. Chop cooked bacon.
2. Lay out tortillas; add egg, bacon and cheese to one half and fold.
3. Toast on flat top until browned and cheese is melted.
4. Cut in halves and serve with salsa.
notes: Use one large quesadilla per person. Can be assembled in advance and fired in batches.

name: Taco Tuesday
ingredients:
10 lb | Ground beef or regular taco meat
1 | full basket Tortilla chips
2 lb | Shredded lettuce
| lb Shredded cheese
1 qt | Salsa
1 qt | Taco sauce, if used
4 lb | dry Rice or prepared rice equivalent
As needed | Taco seasoning, black olives, onions and other standard
| toppings
method:
1. Brown taco meat and season. Hold hot.
2. Cook rice and hold hot.
3. Set up lettuce, cheese, salsa, olives/onions and other available toppings.
4. Serve two tacos per person with rice and salad/toppings.
notes: Keep Taco Tuesday standardized so the off-day meal is easy for the crew to execute.

name: French Toast Sticks, Bacon & Fresh Fruit
ingredients:
20 slices | Bread
2 carton | Liquid Eggs
1 gal | Milk or buttermilk/milk blend
| 6oz Sugar
1.5 oz | Vanilla
As needed | Cinnamon, if available
2 Trays | Bacon
5 lb | Fresh fruit
As needed | Butter/oil and syrup
method:
1. Cut bread slices into thick sticks.
2. Whisk eggs, milk, sugar, vanilla and cinnamon.
3. Dip bread quickly and cook in batches on greased flat top until browned and cooked through.
4. Cook bacon on sheet pans or flat top and drain.
5. Serve French toast sticks with bacon, fruit and syrup.
notes: Do not oversoak the bread. Sheet-pan bacon keeps labor down.

name: Pulled BBQ Chicken over Mac & Cheese with Green Beans
ingredients:
15 | Chicken breast, cooked and pulled or chopped
1 gal | BBQ sauce
6 lb | Penne
4 lb | American cheese and/or mozzarella blend
1 1/2 gal | Milk
1 lb | Butter
1 lb | Flour
1 lb | Romano cheese
2 #10 | cans Green beans
As needed | Salt, pepper, garlic
method:
1. Cook pasta until just tender; drain.
2. Make a quick cheese sauce: melt butter, whisk in flour, add milk, then melt in cheeses and Romano.
3. Fold pasta into cheese sauce and hold hot.
4. Warm pulled/chopped chicken with BBQ sauce.
5. Heat green beans and season.
6. Serve mac and cheese topped with BBQ chicken, with green beans on the side.
notes: Excellent use for cooked chicken trim or extra chicken. Keep BBQ chicken as a topping to control protein cost.

name: BLT Sandwiches with Chips or Fruit
ingredients:
40 slices | Bread
2 Trays | Bacon
2 lb | Burger Lettuce
10 | Tomatoes, sliced
1 qt | Mayonnaise
2 bags | Chips or fruit
As needed | Black pepper
method:
1. Cook bacon on sheet pans until crisp; drain.
2. Toast bread if desired.
3. Spread mayonnaise on bread, then build sandwiches with lettuce, tomato and bacon.
4. Cut and serve with chips or fruit.
notes: Keep Thursday simple since this is an off-day meal. One substantial BLT per person.

name: Meatball Sandwiches on Tomaro's Bread with Fries & Salad
ingredients:
60 | Meatballs cut in half
1 gal | Tomato/meat sauce
60 slices | Tomaro's bread
2 lb | Mozzarella/provolone
1.5 bags | Frozen fries
3 lbs | Salad mix
1 gal | Assorted dressing
method:
1. Heat meatballs in sauce until fully hot.
2. Split or portion Tomaro's bread. Fill each with 2-3 meatballs and sauce.
3. Top with cheese and melt briefly in oven.
4. Cook fries in batches and toss salad.
5. Serve one sandwich per person with fries and salad.
notes: Use Tomaro's bread instead of hoagie buns. Portion meatballs tightly to control cost.

name: Pancakes, Bacon & Fresh Fruit
ingredients:
40 | Medium pancakes
2 Trays | Bacon
5 lb | Fresh fruit
As needed | Pancake batter or flour/buttermilk/egg mix
As needed | Butter and syrup
method:
1. Cook bacon on sheet pans or flat top; drain.
2. Cook pancakes in batches on flat top, approximately two per person.
3. Hold pancakes covered only briefly so they stay soft.
4. Serve with bacon, fresh fruit, butter and syrup.
notes: Use house pancake mix if available; otherwise a standard buttermilk batter works.

name: Chicken Alfredo Pasta with Garlic Bread & Salad
ingredients:
12 pieces | Chicken breast, sliced
1 | full pan Penne or Rig
1.5 gal | Heavy cream
2 lb | Butter
3 lb | Romano cheese
8 oz | Fresh garlic, minced
30 portions | Garlic bread
8-10 lb | Salad mix
1 gal | Assorted dressing
As needed | Salt, black pepper and parsley
method:
1. Cook pasta in salted water and drain.
2. Season and cook sliced chicken quickly on flat top or sauté station; verify 165°F.
3. Heat butter and garlic, add cream, bring to a simmer, then whisk in Romano until smooth.
4. Fold pasta and chicken into sauce. Adjust consistency with pasta water if needed.
5. Serve with garlic bread and salad.
notes: Keep chicken sliced thin so it cooks quickly. Romano provides most of the flavor, so avoid over-seasoning.

name: Eggs, Home Fries & Toast
ingredients:
3 cartons | Liquid Eggs, scrambled
18 lb | Idaho potatoes, small dice
3 | White Onions, diced
30 slices | Bread
As needed | Oil/butter
As needed | Salt, black pepper, garlic and paprika
method:
1. Start diced potatoes on flat top with oil; cover or steam briefly if needed to speed cooking.
2. Add onions and season. Cook until browned and tender.
3. Scramble eggs in large batches and hold hot.
4. Toast bread in batches.
5. Serve eggs with home fries and two slices of toast.
notes: Small-dice potatoes are essential for a 30-minute meal. Par-cooked potatoes can be used if available.

name: Flatbread Pizzas with Salad
ingredients:
8 | Piadina Shells, cut after baking
0.5 gal | Pizza/tomato sauce
3 lb | Shredded mozzarella
3-4 lb | Pepperoni, optional
1 lb | Sausage
2 lb | Salad mix
1 qt | Assorted dressing
method:
1. Lay flatbreads on sheet pans.
2. Spread lightly with sauce and top with mozzarella. Add pepperoni/sausage as desired.
3. Bake until cheese is melted and edges are crisp.
4. Cut each flatbread into portions to yield approximately 45 servings.
5. Toss salad and serve.
notes: Use toppings lightly; cheese is the main cost driver. A mix of cheese and pepperoni pizzas keeps cost controlled.

name: Eggs in a Basket with Fruit
ingredients:
40 slices | Bread
40 | Eggs
2 Trays | Bacon
5 lb | Fresh fruit
As needed | Butter, salt and pepper
method:
1. Cook bacon on sheet pans and drain.
2. Scramble eggs in large batches.
3. Toast bread. Build open-face or sandwich-style portions with egg, bacon and cheese.
4. Warm briefly to melt cheese.
5. Serve with fresh fruit.
notes: Open-face portions can reduce bread use if needed; keep one full breakfast portion per employee.

name: Chicken Pot Pie-Style Biscuit Bake with Green Beans
ingredients:
10 lb | Chicken breast/tenders, cooked and diced
1 qt | Carrots, diced
1 | pint Corn, drained
1 | pint Onions, diced
| 2gal Chicken gravy / cream sauce
45 | Biscuits
| 2#10 cans Green beans
As needed | Butter, salt, black pepper, garlic and poultry/chicken
| seasoning
method:
1. Cook onions and carrots until just tender; add corn/peas.
2. Fold in diced cooked chicken and hot chicken gravy/cream sauce. Season.
3. Transfer hot filling to hotel pans.
4. Top with biscuits and bake until biscuits are browned and filling is bubbling.
5. Heat green beans and season. Serve on the side.
notes: For a true 30-minute pickup, use cooked chicken or small-diced chicken cooked first on the flat top. Do not overload the pans or the biscuit tops will take too long.
